description: Makes the system disk of an existing machine larger, without stopping it: the same disk grown, not a second one, and it can never be shrunk again. Monthly machines get an invoice for the difference, pro rata of the current period, paid from credit when the balance covers it (otherwise the invoice is returned); hourly machines see their rate go up at once. Call it with dry_run first and show the price. Then get_vm: specs.disk_resize reads resizing, then restart_to_use until the guest is restarted (Linux) or the volume extended (Windows). Scope: vms.create.

dry_run.description: true prices the change and creates nothing.

extra_disk_gb.description: New total of gigabytes on top of the plan's disk (not an increment), larger than the current one: one of the sizes under extra_disk in list_plans.

payment.description: Monthly machines only. credit (default) pays from the balance when it covers the invoice; manual always returns the invoice.

vm.description: Machine id, as returned by list_vms or create_vm.

name: grow_vm_disk
title: Grow a machine's system disk
